profile.headline: Master of Science in Software Engineering | Object-Oriented Design Approaches | Software Development | Business Intelligence Development | Data Analysis | Team Collaboration | Agile Methodologies
profile.summary:
I have always had a curious spirit and a natural head for analysis, leading me to find oddities even when I wasn’t looking for them. Since I continuously investigate and ask questions, I have repeatedly discovered bugs that got past tech and QA teams. 

With an extensive background in data analysis, business intelligence, and domain management, I have developed a unique approach to software engineering. My background enables me to develop software systems for organizations according to the data they need to use to build agile and sustainable infrastructures. 

As an engaging professional, I strive to be a critical partner to executive leadership teams. When Endurance International Group was interested in purchasing the BuyDomains brand, I helped the C-suite team pull large volumes of data regarding historical sales and the makeup of the portfolio. Our efforts helped prove the brand would be a healthy, low risk investment. 

When I'm not working, you can find me exercising or reading – mostly science fiction and fantasy, although, I am exploring more classics and nonfiction literature too.  

If you would like to connect or know more about my professional story, please send me an InMail message or email me at ngreen04@gmail.com. 

Key Strengths: SQL | SSRS | Salesforce | Team Collaboration | Business Communication | Business Intelligence Development | Agile Methodologies | Software Engineering

positions.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
positions.description:
Collaborated with clients and team members to find solutions for client needs.  Participated in all aspects of Agile methodologies, including sprint planning, backlog grooming, and daily standups.  Supported junior developers with training, code reviews, and assistance investigating bugs.
• Standardized CSV export functionality for JSP reports by creating Java classes to centralize repeated elements in existing reports.
• Designed and implemented a JavaScript filter to remove unwanted tests from incoming HL7 messages, automating that manual task.
• Coded a customer facing form with Groovy to map data entered by end users to the MA disease surveillance system.

positions.title: Senior Inventory Analyst
positions.description:
Participated in Extract, Transform, and Load (ETL) activities to ensure vital data was implemented into data warehouse. Aided finance department in invoice reconciliations, variance analysis, and forecasting. Monitored domain portfolio monetization efforts. 
•	Generated $200K in sales in FY2020 by drafting a report to identify domains for a specific buyer
•	Created a comprehensive, detailed documentation in Confluence that provided users with instructions on how to request access to and navigate the system as well as a description and delivery information for existing reports

positions.title: Quality Assurance Analyst
positions.description:
Interfaced with manager and supervisor to conceptualize testing plan for company website. Assisted with resolving bugs and system issues. 
•	Contributed to developing and instituting agile methodologies; participated in SCRUM and sprint planning meetings, story grooming sessions, and sprint retrospectives
•	Collaborated with three team members to design release notes based on new features deployed to users 
•	Performed customer inquiries testing stage to determine if new features would integrate effectively with external applications that were part of company-wide system

positions.title: Senior Inventory Analyst
positions.description:
Analyzed domain portfolio monetization metrics to support decisions to change business partnerships and domain templates. Owned all data analysis and processing activities, such as developing an automated reporting system. Assisted finance department with invoice reconciliation, variance analysis, and forecast drafting. 
•	Discovered and identified root cause of bugs in back-end systems and reported business impact and possible fixes to superiors
•	Increased leads by 100% and reduced the impact of technical issues on monetization channels by analyzing metrics on a portfolio with one million domain names 
•	Designed and introduced a complex dashboard for reporting domain parking Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), enabling executive leadership to easily identify and resolve technical issues 
•	Improved audit performance, leading to reduced inventory loss and improved inventory integrity

positions.title: BI Developer, Business Analyst
positions.description:
Trained 50% of coworkers to use new technologies, such as SSRS UI, SSaS cubes, BI, and stack, built by business intelligence team.  
•	Created complex queries, stored procedures, and SSRS reports for all business lines 
•	Analyzed over 10 years of sales to identify popular domain trends and domain attributes and drive the focus of the acquisitions team
•	Evaluated and prepared historical sales and portfolio data for the C-suite team

positions.title: Domain Name Inventory Coordinator
positions.description:
Saved $100,000+ in erroneous payments by designing and invoice reconciliation processes using advanced Excel formulas and pivot tables to review tens of thousands of line items. 
•	Managed the transfer of over 500,000 domains to a single vendor to help solidify a partnership with the second-largest domain name registrar in the world
